item.title: Incarico post-doc: Memory, integration and cultural heritage: jewish communities in Sicily and Southern Italy from the early modern to the contem a period. (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-10 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-03 Storia del pensiero e delle istituzioni politiche

The project investigates the history Of Jewish communities in Sicily and their relations with institutions in the early modern period, highlighting archival sources, Mediterranean netvaorks and the traditions Of the Sicilian Jewish community (Scola Siciliana). Through documentary surveys, institutional history and digital tools, it examines belonging, mobility, integration and heritage preservation. Outputs include a source catalogue, a database of people and places, scholarly publications, and educational and public engagement activities. The research aims to improve knowledge Of Sicily's religious and cultural diversity and support the transmission of its historical memory.
